name: WordPress.com
description: WordPress.com lets agents read posts, pages, comments, and site settings, and draft content on the sites of the signed-in account. Each user signs in to their own WordPress.com account through the browser and chooses full or read-only access.

prompts.text: List my ten most recent posts and their publish status.
Which comments on my site are waiting for moderation?
Draft a post about our spring opening hours, but do not publish it.

apps.name: WordPress.com
apps.description: Site, post, and comment access, over WordPress.com's MCP server with browser sign-in.
